title: Juicy Earthy Date Stir-fry
description: A unique earthy and juicy date-night dish featuring Jamaican flavors with basil for a gluten-free-friendly meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a wok or large skillet over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and sauté for about 1 minute until fragrant but not browned.
Increase heat to high, add pitted dates, and stir-fry for about 5 minutes until they start to caramelize slightly.
Toss in the fresh basil leaves, salt, and pepper. Stir well to combine with the other ingredients.
Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer gently for another 5-10 minutes or until the dates are fully tenderized and the flavors meld together.
Garnish with extra basil if desired before serving.
